topic_title: Legal Definition of Intoxication in Texas
prompt: Can a motorist be convicted of DWI in Texas for consuming legally prescribed prescription medications?

options.text: No, valid pharmacy prescriptions provide absolute legal immunity from DWI
Only if the driver refuses to show the pharmacy prescription bottle label
Yes, if the medication deprives the driver of normal mental or physical faculties
No, Texas DWI statutes apply exclusively to illegal street narcotics and beer
